objective: Implement immutable quick, standard, assurance, and inspect workflow profiles while preserving adaptive 0.99 requirements closure and every applicable Core-owned Gate.
included: Closed profile definitions and deterministic resolution with standard as default.
Deferred-obligation recording for bounded quick-profile verification lanes.
Cross-profile requirements closure and Gate-retention conformance.
excluded: Profile-selected workflow improvisation, Gate bypass, or model-owned progression.
deliverables: Workflow profile resolver, policy catalog, and conformance fixtures.
verificationMethod: Run clear, ambiguous, risky, resumed, deferred-obligation, unknown-profile, and attempted-Gate-bypass fixtures across all four profiles.
successCriteria: Every profile resolves byte-identically, retains 0.99 closure and applicable Gates, and records rather than hides deferred verification.

objective: Implement the eight-operation supported root facade without exposing ordinary callers to internal invocation, checkpoint, graph, or Gate construction.
included: createDevRelay, createLocalHost, defineModule, definePlugin, run, resume, verify, and inspect.
Provider-neutral input normalization, stable results, and exact artifact references.
Installed-package type and runtime conformance.
excluded: New workflow authority, hidden grants, or direct mutable access to Core internals.
deliverables: Supported root facade, TypeScript declarations, examples, and installed-package tests.

dependencyHints.rationale: Facade run operations resolve an exact approved workflow profile.

verificationMethod: Exercise all eight operations from a packed installation, including invalid project, profile, host, run, approval, and stale-resume cases.
successCriteria: An ordinary caller completes supported operations using only facade contracts while every internal authority boundary remains enforced.

objective: Enforce the supported root, advanced subpath, optional pack, and compat/v1 API tiers for one prerelease compatibility window.
included: Export inventory and import-boundary enforcement.
compat/v1 forwarding with machine-readable deprecation and removal metadata.
Migration examples and installed-package negative fixtures.
excluded: Premature physical package splitting or compatibility aliases without an explicit removal window.
deliverables: API tier manifest, compat/v1 adapter, boundary checks, and migration fixtures.

dependencyHints.rationale: API tiers expose the finalized facade and map displaced APIs to it.

verificationMethod: Inventory exports, scan forbidden imports, exercise supported root and subpath imports, and run old-to-compat and compat-to-facade migrations.
successCriteria: Only documented root exports are supported, advanced contracts require explicit subpaths, and compat/v1 remains deterministic for exactly one prerelease cycle.

objective: Implement durable transactional lifecycle state and content-addressed artifact persistence for the Windows local reference host.
included: SQLite schema, migrations, state versions, approvals, checkpoints, graph references, leases, and integrity checks.
Immutable artifact bytes keyed by SHA-256 with media type, byte count, provenance, and retrieval verification.
Failure injection at transaction and artifact boundaries.
excluded: Hosted storage, mutable artifact replacement, or unversioned schema migration.
deliverables: SQLite state store, CAS artifact store, migrations, and recovery fixtures.
verificationMethod: Run migration, optimistic-version, transaction rollback, lease, digest mismatch, missing artifact, concurrent write, restart, and corruption fixtures on Windows.
successCriteria: Every authoritative transition and artifact is durably exact, atomic, recoverable, and rejected on stale or corrupt state.

objective: Provide isolated Git worktrees and deny-by-default capability enforcement for every bounded execution attempt.
included: Exact repository revision and work-item workspace binding.
Filesystem, process, network, and secret grant enforcement with effect receipts.
Path-escape, stale-worktree, over-grant, cleanup, and concurrent-work fixtures.
excluded: Shared mutable execution directories or advisory-only permission declarations.
deliverables: Worktree manager, capability enforcer, and adversarial isolation tests.

dependencyHints.rationale: Worktree and grant state must be transactionally persisted.

verificationMethod: Exercise isolated, concurrent, interrupted, stale-base, path-escape, undeclared-process, undeclared-network, secret, and cleanup scenarios.
successCriteria: Each attempt operates only in its exact worktree with externally enforced declared grants and complete effect receipts.

objective: Bind one exact ChatGPT Desktop/Codex executor to authorized work and recover interrupted runs without duplicating completed or uncertain effects.
included: Executor identity, capability, grant, worktree, and idempotency validation.
Prepared, recorded, reconciled, quarantined, and resumed effect states.
Crash injection across effect, checkpoint, graph, Git, and evidence boundaries.
excluded: Executor self-authorization, silent substitution, or blind retry of uncertain effects.
deliverables: Desktop executor binding, recovery coordinator, and crash matrix.

dependencyHints.rationale: Executor effects require an exact isolated worktree and enforced grants.
Recovery requires durable state, checkpoints, and immutable receipts.

verificationMethod: Inject failures before and after every persistence and external-effect boundary, restart the host, and reconcile exact state and receipts.
successCriteria: Recovery neither duplicates a completed effect nor guesses an uncertain effect, and every resume binds the same approved executor and work item.

objective: Implement the deterministic Windows operator CLI for init, run, resume, status, verify, inspect, and evidence operations.
included: Versioned commands, stable exit codes, JSON output, concise human output, and evidence references.
Malformed input, clarification, approval, failure, recovery, and interrupted-run handling.
Packed-install Windows command matrix.
excluded: Interactive authority hidden outside artifacts or printing secret values.
deliverables: Operator CLI, command contracts, help, and installed-package matrix.

dependencyHints.rationale: CLI commands are a thin operator surface over the supported facade.
Run and resume commands depend on durable executor and recovery behavior.

verificationMethod: Run the complete command matrix from a packed installation on Windows and compare exact JSON, text, exit-code, and evidence outputs.
successCriteria: Every command is deterministic, scriptable, concise by default, and losslessly linked to exact lifecycle evidence.

objective: Publish full immutable lifecycle evidence as checksum-bound GitHub Release assets while retaining compact reviewable evidence in Git.
included: Asset manifest, redaction scan, media types, SHA-256 digests, byte counts, provenance, upload request, and clean-checkout retrieval verifier.
Preview versus stable review disposition.
No-history-rewrite enforcement.
excluded: Public npm publication, hosted backend storage, secret-bearing assets, or rewriting evidence history.
deliverables: Evidence asset publisher, manifest/verifier, and release workflow integration.

dependencyHints.rationale: Release assets are built from exact locally retained CAS artifacts.

verificationMethod: Create a candidate asset, publish or emulate the bounded upload, retrieve it from a clean checkout, verify every hash and media type, and exercise missing, stale, secret, and preview cases.
successCriteria: Every summarized claim resolves to immutable retrievable evidence, and stable status is impossible without exact independent human review.

objective: Keep Godot and GdUnit4 as optional pack bindings under a reusable domain-pack contract that can also describe a future TypeScript web-service pack.
included: Pack manifest, discovery, permission, dependency, maturity, and rollback conformance.
Godot/GdUnit4 fixture plus a provider-neutral synthetic web-service pack fixture.
Generic Core product-identifier scan.
excluded: Shipping a TypeScript web-service pack in SIM-001 or adding Godot-specific branches to Generic Core.
deliverables: Optional-pack contract, Godot binding migration, and cross-domain conformance fixtures.

dependencyHints.rationale: Optional packs are exposed through the approved pack API tier.
Pack effects use the same grant enforcement as every other adapter.

verificationMethod: Run discovery, dependency, permission, unavailable, rollback, identifier-scan, and cross-domain manifest fixtures.
successCriteria: Both domain fixtures conform through one provider-neutral pack contract and Generic Core contains no domain-specific routing branch.

objective: Align package metadata, migration guidance, release notes, and review policy with the 0.10.0-rc.2 simplification preview and deferred 0.11 durable-host milestone.
included: Version matrix, changelog, compatibility window, preview labeling, independent-review requirement, and Module-version independence.
Facade, CLI, profile, advanced API, and migration documentation.
excluded: Claiming stable status without independent review or conflating package and Module versions.
deliverables: Versioned preview documentation, migration guide, changelog, and release-review policy.

dependencyHints.rationale: Migration guidance must describe the final API tiers and compat/v1 behavior.
Operator documentation must match the shipped CLI surface.

verificationMethod: Validate all version declarations, links, command examples, deprecation metadata, preview labels, and negative mixed-version fixtures.
successCriteria: Every public artifact consistently identifies 0.10.0-rc.2 as preview and reserves durable-host completion for 0.11 without overstating maturity.

objective: Make the complete verification gate transition-safe by decoupling historical V0.11 fixtures from mutable current-project baselines and adding exhaustive SIM-001 conformance.
included: Repair the five observed baseline-coupled failures without weakening historical digest assertions.
Facade, profiles, API tiers, durable host, CLI, packs, evidence, crash, and compatibility negative tests.
Installed-package and Windows matrix coverage.
excluded: Updating expected digests merely to hide drift or deleting immutable historical fixtures.
deliverables: Transition-safe historical fixtures and complete SIM-001 regression suites.

dependencyHints.rationale: Boundary tests require the final API and compatibility surface.
Crash and recovery tests require the completed host execution path.
Pack tests require the finalized optional-pack contract.
Profile conformance tests require the exact policy resolver.

verificationMethod: Run the canonical verify gate, targeted historical-fixture tests, mutation and negative suites, installed-package verification, and the Windows Node matrix.
successCriteria: The full gate is green, historical candidates remain immutable and independently reproducible, and SIM-001 failures cannot be masked by mutable project state.

objective: Prove the simplified product through one clean-checkout production-quality software change on ChatGPT Desktop for Windows and publish it through bounded stacked review changes.
included: Standard-profile facade and CLI lifecycle from Goal through BusinessAcceptance.
Exact checkpoints, graph, code, tests, integration, evidence asset, compact report, and owner decision.
Bounded stacked pull requests that preserve the immutable V0.11 pair before closing the oversized predecessor.
excluded: Public npm publication, one-click Desktop plug-in, hosted backend, or stable-release claim without independent review.
deliverables: Clean-checkout Windows dogfood, release candidate, stacked review series, and acceptance package.

dependencyHints.rationale: The release-defining Desktop run uses the shipped CLI.
The end-to-end candidate must publish and retrieve exact evidence.
The release candidate requires a green complete verification gate.
Release metadata and handoff must match the approved preview scope.

verificationMethod: From a clean GitHub checkout on Windows, run the standard-profile lifecycle against a small real project, independently reconstruct evidence, verify stacked changes, and obtain exact BusinessAcceptance.
successCriteria: A ChatGPT Desktop user can build and accept a production-quality change end to end through the simplified supported surface with deterministic replay and independently verifiable evidence.
